caption: 🚨WATCH: 🇮🇱Tens of thousands of bees suddenly swarm Israel.
Tens of thousands of bees suddenly swarmed parts of Israel, particularly the southern city of Netivot, causing panic among residents and forcing authorities to issue safety warnings. ￼

Videos circulating online show huge clouds of bees covering streets, cars, and buildings, especially around a commercial center in the city. Local officials urged residents and shop owners to stay indoors and keep doors and windows closed until the swarm disperses. ￼
Experts say the phenomenon was likely a mass hive swarm, when a bee colony splits and thousands of bees leave together to find a new location for their hive. ￼
No major injuries have been reported so far, but authorities warned people not to approach the insects while specialists work to relocate them. ￼
